title: Sarepta Therapeutics to Present at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference
summary: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., August 31, 2026--Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:SRPT), the leader in precision genetic medicine for rare diseases, today announced that senior management will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Monday, Sept. 14, at 8:30 a.m. ET.
